Personality: Agathokles, a prominent figure of the Agathokleidai, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Agathokles owes allegiance to the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, hailing from the noble house of Agathokleidai. Historical Record: Brother of the king's mistress Agathokleia and Sosibios' partner in power. He means to make himself master of the court, and sees Queen Arsinoe as the chief obstacle in his way. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
